data.revised_prompt: Square 1:1 centered icon-style portrait asset for a school student avatar library, single fictional Chinese girl age 8-14, healthy, natural, friendly. High-quality 3D chibi educational app art style, same refined sculpting and soft materials as AI homeroom assistant / principal assistant avatars, but clearly a student. Composition must be tightly focused on the head: face and hair occupy 75%-85% of the square, with only a very small amount of neck and white school collar visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. Full hair silhouette visible, no top crop, no chin crop, no hair crop. Slight front or mild 3/4 view. Distinct bright brown eyes, open cheerful toothy smile, cute but not overly infantile. Hairstyle: high ponytail, thin airy bangs, bright yellow hair tie. Simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Background must fully fill the entire square edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no scene. Use a muted mint-teal background. Bottom should show only a tiny bit of white school collar, no logo, no text, no emblem. Clean studio soft lighting, pleasant and clear for 48px student list and PC rectangle identification. Single character only, centered, polished, high clarity, no realistic photo look, no flat 2D illustration, no shadows obscuring facial features.
